newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes low in ranged trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes low in ranged trade.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed soft against the dollar on Wednesday after moving in a tight range as the market recovered from a long holiday, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.95 to the dollar after opening at 58.90. The rupee closed at 58.86 to the dollar on Friday, the last trading day before the Sinhala and Tamil new year holiday.
"There was hardly any demand for dollars with many customers still on holiday," said a Deutsche Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at 8.5 percent after opening at 10, with the market well offered.
